additions.name: nexspace Graz — four-storey data-centre extension

status.summary: The original planner and builder report states that nexspace started construction of the extension to its Graz data centre with the August 26 groundbreaking. DCG completed the design and now undertakes construction of the four-storey extension. This supports the construction start of one extension within the existing commercial campus, not completion, operating expansion capacity or a second site.

locator.precision: Exact native named data-centre point locating the parent campus; not a surveyed entrance, parcel, extension footprint or individual server hall.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The native feature reports no measured positional accuracy. No office guess, city centroid, industrial-zone centre or image registration is used.
locator.identity_review: Native nexspace data centers GmbH Graz links the exact official Graz facility page and gives Alte Poststraße 390. The official detailed facility table identifies GRZ1 at 390, and its directions link independently selects the native 390 address feature about 1.4 metres away. The site footer gives 376, which remains an explicitly different address entry rather than an asserted equivalent entrance. The primary construction reports call the development an addition to the existing Graz facility. The selected point locates that campus; it is not the construction boundary.

additions.distinctness_review: All five snapshot 114 tables and historical/current queues are screened for nexspace, COOLtec, DISTINGUENDUS, GRZ1, address variants and coordinates. One physical Graz campus encompasses the existing host and this extension. Historical third-party Graz 1/Graz 2 labels do not create separate sites. The thirty-fourth and eighty-ninth location holds are reopened only because the exact current operator facility page and native map feature now resolve the location. Citycom, EXA and XINON at Neufeldweg, Heidelberg and Stuttgart are separate facilities.
additions.successor_review: Current operator facility page, news index and original company feed through October 8 were reviewed. October 6 concerns generic location selection; October 8 announces future November tours at Heidelberg and Stuttgart and does not refresh Graz. No later achieved completion, opening, pause, cancellation or relocation was found. Conflicting September/end-of-2027 extension forecasts remain unachieved.

scoped_project_details.facility_scope: One commercial campus with one extension project
scoped_project_details.limitations: Construction start only. No completed extension, current operating expansion capacity, measured load, whole-campus completion, surveyed boundary or certification validity is asserted. Historical commissioning and energy figures are not adopted.

additions.name: Liquid Web Lansing DC3 — existing commercial data-centre operation

status.summary: The original September 23 operator incident identifies the DC3-LAN physical host, reports an actual PSU replacement, and confirms affected servers are back online and operating normally. This supports existing operation at the named commercial campus, without asserting a new opening, capacity, occupancy or measured performance.

locator.precision: Exact native named-facility campus anchor, not a city, corporate address geocode, surveyed property boundary or standalone carrier point.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Native source gives no quantitative positional accuracy. Decimal precision does not establish surveyed accuracy.
locator.identity_review: Native DC3 name, Lansing and liquidweb.com match the primary operator incident; primary assessor PCA independently names 2703 Ena Drive as a Liquid Web data-centre physical property, distinct from 4428 Creyts. Native listed organization field CMN-RUS/Metronet is not asserted as operator or owner. The native ZIP 48933 is retained as reported and not silently reconciled to corporate mailing ZIP 48917. Operator A/B labels are not assigned to DC3.

additions.distinctness_review: All five canonical 114 tables and 3974 current/historical source, definition, hold, queue and review files screened by native ID, exact address/point and facility/operator/legacy names. No baseline hit; the sole historical Lansing hold is explicitly reopened with the new primary repair report. All five former integration18 admissions are canonical 114 and excluded.
additions.successor_review: The original incident API and RSS were reviewed through October 29. September 25 named DC3 scheduled maintenance is reported complete and retained as later context. October 31-November 1 work is explicitly future scheduled maintenance. Neither changes the selected September 23 existing-operation observation into an opening, capacity expansion or generic dashboard inference. No later closure or relocation was found in this bounded review.
